sources.title: Elven Chain (passive feature)
markers: | description = You are considered [[Proficient]] with this armour while wearing it.

sources.title: Elven Agility
markers: | description = The wearer has a +2 bonus to [[Initiative]] Rolls and {{Advantage}} on [[Dexterity]] {{Saving Throw}}s.

summary: Medium armour that anyone can wear proficiently, with +2 Initiative and advantage on Dexterity saves.

fields.Armour Class: Base AC 14 plus Dexterity modifier, maximum +2.
fields.Proficiency: Wearer is considered proficient. The linked item notes say unarmoured bonuses can remain active.
fields.Elven Agility: +2 Initiative and advantage on Dexterity saves.
fields.Defence style: Hidden +1 AC for the Defence fighting style. Another eligible armour piece can also activate the normal +1 AC.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
